title: Shrinkage (Theft and Loss) Rate Analysis
sourcePath: data/analysis-library/retail/34 - Shrinkage (Theft and Loss) Rate Analysis.md
goal: The goal of Shrinkage (Theft and Loss) Rate Analysis is to quantify the amount of inventory loss due to theft, administrative errors, vendor fraud, or other reasons that lead to a reduction in inventory without corresponding sales.
dataRequired: Beginning inventory value for the period.
Ending inventory value for the period.
Total sales during the period.
Purchases made during the period.
Documented losses from theft, damage, or other reasons (if available).

formulas.source: Expected Inventory = Beginning Inventory + Purchases - Sales
Shrinkage Rate (%) = (Shrinkage / Sales) x 100

title: Vendor Compliance and Supplier Performance in Retail
sourcePath: data/analysis-library/retail/35 - Vendor Compliance and Supplier Performance in Retail.md
goal: The goal of the Vendor Compliance and Supplier Performance Analysis is to evaluate how well vendors and suppliers adhere to contractual agreements and performance metrics.
dataRequired: Delivery timelines (agreed vs. actual delivery times).
Order accuracy rates (correct items, quantities, and speciﬁcations).
Product quality data (returns, defects, or customer complaints related to supplier products).
Vendor ﬁll rates (percentage of orders fulﬁlled completely).
Contractual terms with each supplier (e.g., pricing, delivery schedules, penalties for non- compliance).
Supplier lead times.
Supplier performance history (e.g., past compliance issues or trends).

formulas.source: Delivery Compliance (%) = (Number of On-Time Deliveries / Total Deliveries) x 100
Order Accuracy (%) = (Number of Correct Orders / Total Orders) x 100
Vendor Fill Rate (%) = (Number of Items Delivered / Number of Items Ordered) x 100
Defect Rate (%) = (Number of Defective Products / Total Products Received) x 100
